verdict.rationale: Sumsub documents a RESTful API for processing applicant data and documents with "full control over the verification flow," plus webhooks and an official MCP server that lets agents perform Sumsub operations under role permissions. That gives broad programmatic access, but nothing establishes UI parity: level configuration, manual approve/reject, team management and branding are all described as Dashboard workflows, and no OpenAPI spec was found at any probed path. Missing for 10: an explicit API/UI parity statement, documented API endpoints for dashboard features (level builder, team/role management, branding, manual review), a machine-readable OpenAPI spec, and independent corroboration.
